questions.question_english:
With reference to the following, consider these statements regarding the 'Management of Minority Schools':
I. The management has the right to select its Head of School regardless of seniority, provided the candidate meets the minimum qualifications.
II. The Director's nominee is not required in the selection committee of an unaided minority school.
III. The school can admit 100% students from the majority community and still retain its minority status indefinitely. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I and III only
II and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: I and II only Under Article 30(1), minority school management can select qualified Heads of School without strict seniority restrictions, and Director nominees are not mandatory on unaided minority selection committees. However, admitting 100% majority students compromises minority character, making statements I and II correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत की उत्तर-कुंजी के अनुसार कथन I और II सही हैं। अनुच्छेद 30(1) अल्पसंख्यकों को शैक्षणिक संस्थान स्थापित और प्रशासित करने का अधिकार देता है; लागू कानून और न्यायिक सिद्धांतों की सीमा में विद्यालय प्रमुख के चयन में प्रबंधन को कुछ स्वायत्तता मिल सकती है। गैर-सहायता-प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक विद्यालय की चयन समिति में निदेशक का प्रतिनिधि सामान्य रूप से अनिवार्य न होने का सिद्धांत भी लागू हो सकता है। कथन III सही नहीं है, क्योंकि अल्पसंख्यक दर्जे का दावा केवल नाम से नहीं, बल्कि संबंधित समुदाय और संस्थान के वास्तविक संबंधों तथा लागू कानूनी कसौटियों से निर्धारित होता है।
questions.topic: Delhi Education Act, 1973 and Delhi School Education Rules, 1973
key_facts: Correct answer: A. I and II only

I and II only Under Article 30(1), minority school management can select qualified Heads of School without strict seniority restrictions, and Director nominees are not mandatory on unaided minority selection committees. However, admitting 100% majority students compromises minority character, making statements I and II correct.

questions.question_english: Which of the following describes the correct procedure for amending the Scheme of Management of a recognized private school?
options_english: The Principal can amend the scheme directly through an executive order.
Committee passes a resolution and submits it to the Director for approval.
The Parent-Teacher Association passes a resolution that is automatically binding.
It requires a formal statutory amendment by the Legislative Assembly.
questions.explanation_english: The Scheme of Management is a formally approved governance document, so it cannot be amended solely by a Principal's executive order or by a PTA resolution. The Managing Committee should adopt a resolution and submit the proposed amendment to the Director for approval in accordance with the Rules. A statutory amendment by the Legislative Assembly is not ordinarily required for every change to an individual school's scheme; the prescribed approval process governs it.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही प्रक्रिया में प्रबंध समिति द्वारा प्रस्ताव पारित करना और निर्धारित अनुमोदन के लिए निदेशक को प्रस्तुत करना शामिल है। प्रबंधन-योजना विद्यालय के शासन, भूमिकाओं और प्रक्रियाओं को औपचारिक रूप देती है, इसलिए उसे केवल प्रधानाचार्य के एकपक्षीय आदेश या PTA प्रस्ताव से स्वतः नहीं बदला जा सकता। दूसरी ओर, योजना में हर संशोधन के लिए अलग से अधिनियम बदलना आवश्यक नहीं होता; नियमों में निर्धारित प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया अपनाई जाती है।

questions.question_english: What is the primary purpose of the "Recognized Private Schools' Fund" mandated under Section 18 of the DSEA 1973?

To credit all fees collected and ensure their use solely for school purposes

questions.question_english: What is the scope of the "Right to Education" as harmonized with the Delhi School Education Rules, 1973 regarding detention of students?
options_english: Students can be detained in Class 5 if they fail regular term examinations.
No-detention applies up to Class 8, with Class 5/8 detention allowed after re-exam.
Students can be freely detained in any class if overall attendance falls below 50%.
Mandatory no-detention policy applies uniformly to all students up to Class 10.
questions.explanation_english: No-detention applies up to Class 8, with Class 5/8 detention allowed after re-exam. Under harmonized RTE guidelines and updated Delhi School Education Rules, no-detention applies generally through elementary education, but allows schools to hold regular examinations in Classes 5 and 8. If a student fails re-examination provided after remedial instruction, the school is legally permitted to detain the student in Class 5 or 8.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत प्रश्न के अनुसार नो-डिटेंशन नीति सामान्यतः कक्षा 8 तक लागू रहती है, लेकिन निर्धारित परीक्षा और पुनःपरीक्षा प्रक्रिया के बाद कक्षा 5 या 8 में रोकने की अनुमति संबंधित संशोधित प्रावधानों के अधीन हो सकती है। इसलिए न तो नियमित परीक्षा में असफल होते ही स्वतः रोकना सही है और न ही सभी कक्षाओं में बिना अपवाद रोकने या न रोकने का दावा सही है।
